title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
html: My top 10 things to watch Monday, Nov. 16 1. Nvidia is leading the Nasdaq and other AI stocks lower in premarket trading , as the fallout of Jensen Huang's exit continues. Some are reporting that he's discussing a comeback , but we need some realism here. Nvidia is down almost 4%. Nasdaq futures are off 1.4%. S & P and Dow futures are also in the red. Oil and bonds are mostly calm. 2. Longtime CFO Colette Kress is the steady hand that Nvidia needs as interim CEO, as I argued in my Sunday column for Investing Club subscribers. She faces a huge test Tuesday night, when Nvidia reports earnings. Operating cash flow will be scrutinized. Will they reiterate guidance? Also: What's going to happen to Nvidia's role as the central bank of AI? The Wall Street Journal says those days "are numbered." 3. Anthropic is sharing the spotlight with Nvidia this week, as the Claude creator marches toward its blockbuster IPO. The order book keeps building. Expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday. Hugely important for the broader AI trade, which had been wobbling even before the Nvidia shakeup. We spent a ton of time last week on "Mad Money" previewing the IPO. I still have three lingering questions on the company. 4. The neoclouds are under heavy selling pressure again this morning. Nvidia has been instrumental in building this group up, and everyone is concerned about what happens to them in a Jensen-less regime. Nebius is down 8% premarket. Iren and Hut 8 are down 6%. CoreWeave , the best known of the bunch, is off nearly 8%. That would erase nearly all of CoreWeave's 25% post-earnings surge last week. 5. L3Harris is under fire for Friday's nationwide ground stop, which disrupted flights across the country. Shares of the defense company, which supplies technology for managing and monitoring U.S. commercial air traffic, are down over 3% in premarket trading. But will it matter for the stock long term? These types of things usually don't matter. The issue stemmed from a communications update. Making his first public comments, President Donald Trump on Sunday blamed the Biden administration for making an "old and broken" air traffic control system worse. 6. Bernstein lifted its price target on Marriott International to $479 from $445 and kept its buy rating on the hotel chain's stock. Analysts are encouraged by Marriott's demand trends, especially in the U.S., despite the World Cup bump now in the rearview mirror. Talk about a best-of-breed company. Rarely misses estimates during earnings season. I've been behind this one for ages. 7. Would you have guessed Williams-Sonoma is outpacing the S & P 500 by more than 30 percentage points this year? Well, it's true. Even with a sluggish housing market. Barclays raised its price target to $240 from $190 but kept its rating at hold. Really? That's $14 below where the stock closed Friday. This is another best-of-breed name in its industry, thanks to CEO Laura Alber. Just like Marriott and Ralph Lauren . 8. Ahead of next month's earnings, Ulta Beauty 's price target was increased to $766 from $730 by Jefferies. Looks like that is a Street high. The analysts cited a solid industry backdrop and kept their buy rating. Stands to reason that Ulta could go higher after a great number from e.l.f. Beauty earlier this month. 9. Humana was upgraded to buy from hold at RBC Capital Markets. Analysts see significant earnings growth potential in the coming years after the Medicare Advantage-focused insurer got its house in order. That includes better ratings on the government's grading system for its MA plans. I like the managed-care group here. I think CVS Health is the best because of the planned breakup, though there is some spin purgatory risk. 10. The freight train that is Eli Lilly keeps on running, Barclays wrote to clients, raising its price target on the stock to $1,550 from $1,400. Analysts called out Medicare adoption, international demand and market-share gains in GLP-1s as key drivers of continued growth for Lilly. This has been a home run for us.
